newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ share prices end steady, Telecom recovers.
newsitem.headline: NZ share prices end steady, Telecom recovers.

text.p: * NZ shares end steady after Telecom goes ex-div
* Telecom recovers most ground. Other leaders mixed
* Carter Holt Harvey eases after strong start, recent gains
Price movements at close
LAST CHG * NZSE40 cap index -5.12 at 2,371.02
136 nil * NZSE-10 cap index -4.09 at 1,196.38
353 -3 * NZSC cap index +13.95 at 5,115.10
337 nil * NZMC .NZMC cap index +4.90 at 1,885.14
367 +1 * Volume NZ$42.7 million. Futures +8 at 1,203
716 -3 * Other movers - +10 -5
New Zealand share prices ended steady on Monday with Telecom regaining most of its lost ground after going ex a 10 cents per share dividend.
The NZSE-40 Capital Index, which does not adjust for dividends, ended 5.12 points lower at 2,371.02 on turnover worth a respectable NZ$42.7 million.
The NZSE-40 Gross Index, which does adjust, ended 12.28 points higher at 3,455.15.
Telecom ended just three cents down at NZ$7.16, having earlier hit an intra-day low of $7.10.
Wayne Schuler at Cavill White Securities said it was a reasonable day's trade given Australia was closed for a holiday.
He said the market may have ended on a stronger note had it not been for late weakness in domestic bond prices.
Carter Holt Harvey, despite a strong start, eased off three to close at NZ$3.53.
Among the smaller issues, manufacturer Ceramco lost five cents to close at NZ$1.30 on light volume.
Summit Gold, the volatile gold and uranium explorer, put on 10 cents to NZ$0.53.
-- James Gray, Auckland newsroom +64 9 302 1253
